description: Evolution cycle report: cycle 002 — 2026-09-16 — instance migration 3.5.0-rc.1 → 3.30.0 (OKF split, gate tooling, namespace) plus two staleness fixes.
Next.js — `cookies()` / `headers()` only in a Server Component / route handler
Next.js — `revalidatePath` / `revalidateTag` does not invalidate React Query
Native Node ESM (`prisma/*.ts` via `node`) — you cannot re-import `src/lib/*`
Next.js — Cache Components (`cacheComponents: true`) forbids a route without `<Suspense>`, even if you do not want PPR
Next.js — a `"use cache"` page never knows who is asking (no cookies)
Next.js — a root layout under a dynamic segment leaves `_not-found` orphaned
Hooks (pre-commit/pre-push) — run scoped tests, not the full suite
Zod v3 → v4 — string-format validators became top-level functions (deprecated, not an error)
tRPC — a bare `t.procedure` skips the error-translation middleware
Prisma — never `db push` / `migrate dev` on a model with an `Unsupported` generated column
Dependabot — alerts are evaluated against the default branch, not the branch you are on
How to get this blog crawled and indexed by Google: the discovery channels that work, the Search Console operations, and the priorities after the basic SEO.
How to get a site hosted on the free *.vercel.app host indexed by Google, what verification is possible without owning a domain, and the limits of not buying one.
A missing `/post/<slug>` answered HTTP 200 — fixed with a Proxy existence check on 2026-09-16
Separates a domain error from a procedure error and from an infrastructure error.
Rejects what must not become a durable doc, because a false constraint is poison.
Decides when a DSL is worth suggesting, and when it is premature.
Domain/Procedure does NOT import `PrismaClient`/`@prisma/client`/the Prisma driver directly.
A route handler (`src/app/api/**/route.ts`) is thin.
No direct commit to `main`/`develop`.
A boundary error is classified: recoverable (`AppError`) vs. bug.
PR title and body in English.
`src/shared/**` does not import `@trpc/*`.
The boundary emits one canonical log line per call; the logger never carries a secret.
No backwards-compat shim.
An architectural change stops and asks.
Tokens and secrets do not leak.
Error classification — Domain ≠ Transport.
Validation at the boundary — schema only at a procedure's input/output.
A `/docs/` edit does not collapse the doc.
The capture substrate is append-only.
A recurring, anchored failure becomes remediation, not silent recurrence
No new code without a test
`docs/_focus.md` is small, overwritable slot-state.
INALIENABLE — code and tests are written in English
Zero `any` / `unknown` in your own helpers.
A hard rule with a 0/1 trigger needs a versioned runner in the gate
A doc under `docs/` carries no FILESYSTEM absolute path
The prose of an artifact is English
A Portuguese literal never survives inside a script or inside a quoted marker
An indexed file carries the OKF contract, and an op declares what it writes and composes
A normative doc cites no path that does not exist
Do not commit with a broken type-check.
One responsibility per file.
File ≤ 300 lines.
A domain-like file exports exactly ONE `domain_<action>` function.
